notes: Binary: scratchpad/langs/repocortex. Each language indexed in its own empty directory under scratchpad/langs/work/G6/t/<lang> (v2, vue2, svelte2 hold the extra files); raw file/symbol dumps are in scratchpad/langs/work/G6/out_<dir>.json. Nothing in the repocortex repository was modified.

parse_status 'partial' with NULL parse_error does not mean a syntax error: internal/parse/generic.go sets it when a file parses but yields zero symbols and zero references. That is why TLA+, VHDL, three Teal files, statement-only Swift snippets, and all Verilog/Coq .v files show as partial.

wrong_kind counts only cross-category kinds (e.g. a service or exception labelled 'function'). imprecise_kind counts struct/enum/typedef labelled 'class' and, for Swift only, methods labelled 'function'; these are reported separately and not counted as wrong.

Line rule: a symbol whose start_line is the attribute/decorator line directly above the declaration (Swift @available, WGSL @fragment) is within 2 lines and counted correct. V const-block members are stamped with the 'const (' line; one (nbody.v N) falls 3 lines away and is counted wrong and missed.

Vue and Svelte: tags_probe.tsv says 'no tags query', but the tool extracts from the <script> block with the JS/TS extractor. Two recall figures are given: the primary one counts top-level const/let bindings as expected definitions (per the task wording); *_functions_methods_types_only excludes them.

Timeouts from the first pass were not reproduced on single files with this binary. Slowest: Linguist 'Rocq Prover/JsCorrectness.v' (243 KB Coq, mis-detected as V) 2.4-2.5 s; Linguist 'Type Language/scheme.tl' (74 KB Telegram schema, mis-detected as Teal) 1.36 s. Every genuine file in this group indexed in under 0.3 s. Linguist Teal/teal-cyan-example.tl indexes in 0.14 s (partial, 0 symbols).
Totals over the 12 languages: expected 650, extracted 303, correct 295, wrong 8, missed 355.
